puzzles.title: The detached reading room
puzzles.subtitle: Night Routes
puzzles.story: A maintenance diagram has lost its orientations. Turn the relays into one connected network; every port must meet another port, with none pointing beyond the board.
puzzles.difficultyEvidence: Boundary and reciprocal-port propagation leave unresolved rotations; connected-component reasoning is required by the independent oracle. Provisional editorial tier, not a timed human rating.

puzzles.title: The missing fourteen steps
puzzles.subtitle: Night Routes
puzzles.story: The archivist numbered a route through every floor tile before removing most of the labels. Restore one edge-connected sequence from 1 to 36, using each square once.
